bestBets.overview: Seven race card at Ipswich, track should remain good, rail is out a whopping 10m. Kick things off with a 1710m Maiden Plate with some key scratchings decimating things to some extent. No's 6 & 15 look to be the remaining pace INDAMOUSE won't be rising from 1350m to 1710m in one fell swoop. KOWLOON MAGNATE won't be making the most of a kind map. Conversely  LOTTERY LINK  will be lining up, continually thereabouts, has to be a hope from the inside alley.  MAREMOTO fit and well new blood up from NSW, in the mix. SIR ARROGONCE may need one more but debut indicated will improve over further and there's 360m to traverse today.

raceTips.comment: Midweek racing comes from Ipswich where the weather will be warm & the track rated good. A middle-distance maiden kicks things off, I'll lean to the favourite Sir Arrogonce who did make ground on debut over 1350m, the rise to 1710m looks suitable. Maremoto looms as the main danger coming off recent NSW solid provincial maiden form. Lottery Link improved with the step up in distance last start, lands the right un here from an inside gate. Konigstein not the roughest either, excuses last time closed off well on debut.

bestBets.overview: 1350m QTIS 3yo Maiden Plate. No's 2,4,6,9 look to be the pace.  Don't think there's been a more ugly watch than WEOWNACHEVY last start. A firm favourite to win the 'The most cert beat of cert beats for 2026'. Officially finished 5th but all things being fair may have won by a furlong. Boasted the Exceed The Sale from-line leading into that. As they say in the classics 'there's no such thing as a good thing'. On all of the above is going to win this and win better races as time marches on. CRAZY EIGHTS placed 2nd in that race and I have to say, it was a very nice debut, very nice indeed. THREEEYEDWITCH was 3rd home there, can finish 3rd here. Market likes WIN STAR, no doubt has the talent if last start times are any guide. The alley is the obvious concern.

raceTips.comment: Grafton trained Weownachevy was very unlucky not to finish closer at Doomben last start when held up badly in the home straight. Couple that with a troublesome getaway when striking trouble & you pretty much have a train wreck. Look for a quiet ride here, coming wide near the turn & look to run home over the leaders. Crazy Eights comes out of the same last start race when running well, that was his debut & he's in good hands suggesting he'll benefit greatly from the experience. Win Star will be suited by the step up in distance, not without a chance either.

MEDALS toughed it out admirably when winning this track and distance last start, despite sharing the lead outside the stablemate RUNAROUND SUE. Both are now staying home. Doesn't set up quite to well now for the resuming VEGAS RAIDER which has the talent, just never attempted an 800m scamper before. DIAMANTINA ROSE is an 800m specialist, nice and fresh, has no weight, placed three of three this track/trip thus far. STATE IN TEXAS draws the best, takes a claim, it's been the best backed in early betting.

raceTips.comment: Keen on the chances of the freshened-up Diamantina Rose who placed in town last start over 1000m which was a solid effort as she finds anything beyond 800m a test. That's the trip she's back to today & with Courtney Bellamy's claim is very well in at the weights. Wondereach disappointed first up for the new yard (ex-NSW) having trialled well prior, needs to improve on that perhaps 800m is more suitable? Include State In Texas, record here is a very good one.

TORO STRIKE strips fitter again, include if appearing fancied (hasn't thus far). MISHANI MOET hard and fit, not having much luck lately. TILL DUSK strips fitter, is beginning to look like the making of a non-winner just the same. LEBANESE was rock-solid in defeat this track and distance last start. TEN CARAT LUCY has had a stable change since finally winning 'again'. Alley concerns. BOLSHEVIC ROAD will appreciate dropping back in distance, takes a claim too.

raceTips.comment: Tricky looking race this one. Blueish Hue was strong to the line in a good race last start, fitter third up, 1350m is the query on past attempts. Mishani Moet is worth including, luckless here two back before too far back in town the latest, 10m rail & gate doesn't appeal on the map however stranger things ave happened.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C1.  No's 5,9,13 would appear to be the speed. Initially set up well for something to swoop, we shall know by now if that is at all possible with the rail so far out. The toppy, DYAMI ticks that box, and the claim looks a shrewd move. The stablemate BLUE WHITE BLUE is one of the forward runners, just have to respect how the market treats both, few (if any) better than this yard in going the right way. Sets up well for MAQUISA, kind alley, patient rider just watching it all unfold and then pushing the button when said button needs awakening. ASHKIRK is another that right now could be rewarding a swooping plan.
bestBets.suggestedBet: Win and place 6. Rove 6 in quin with 1,5,10.

raceTips.comment: Leaning to the resuming Murkado who only had 3 runs at his initial prep winning & placing before out of the money in a stronger race prior to spelling. Trials sound should be ready to go. Maquisa likely did enough on debut to give this race a shake. She didn't gain the clearest of runs until well into the straight closing off soundly without getting too excited. Should Andrew Mallyon be able to make use of the inside gate & settle within striking distance he'll just need a gap to appear in the straight to rate a winning chance on this Chris Waller trained mare. Dyami is consistent & looks close however not drawn to advantage. Could take some catching it that's the case. Many other chances.

bestBets.overview: 1100m BM68. Note just ten can run. Setting the pace? Any/all of no's 4,8,10,11,12,13,15. A nation waits to see who of them lines up. The C & C Munce trained SEQUEL trotted in last start, could be the map is oh so favourable it ain't funny. If that is the case the Gollan stablemates YOWERI and ANDI DON'T CARE will map to stalk and be the obvious dangers. If the bulk of the pace gets a start all of a sudden VANESSI comes into calculations big time. Chris Waller must believe that will be the case because here and now Race Six looked the logical play, my word it did. Bottom line, I need to know the final field to form an 'educated/logical' opinion. Fun times.

raceTips.comment: The meeting winds up with an 1100m restricted affair where I'm with the Tony Gollan trained Yoweri who hit the line well here last start & should enjoy the step up in trip. The claim for a very much in form Bella Youngberry a bonus. At odds Jemeldi is worth including, unlucky not to win at Toowoomba, the gate here not ideal however could run into a placing.
